description: Estonian Topographic Database (ETAK) core data, thematic dataset "Transportation" for entire Estonia, layer E_501_tee_j: road. Layer naming: "_p" means point geometry, "_j" line geometry, "_a" polygon geometry and "_ka" polygon geometry on top of the "_a" layers. Downloadable files are updated weekly.

table:columns.name: etak_id
table:columns.description: Unique object ID of the Estonian topographic database.

table:columns.name: kood
table:columns.description: Grouping code of the layer (also part of the layer name).

table:columns.name: kood_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of kood (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: tyyp
table:columns.description: Type of the feature: type

table:columns.name: tyyp_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of tyyp (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: laius
table:columns.description: road width (in full meters) pavement area + bearing edges

table:columns.name: teekate
table:columns.description: pavement type

table:columns.name: teekate_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of teekate (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: liiklus
table:columns.description: road traffic direction

table:columns.name: liiklus_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of liiklus (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: tee
table:columns.description: road code (from road registry)

table:columns.name: teeosa
table:columns.description: code of the logical part of the road (from road registry)

table:columns.name: soidutee
table:columns.description: traffic lane type

table:columns.name: soidutee_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of soidutee (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: tee_synon
table:columns.description: if the road segment is part of another road then its code from road registry

table:columns.name: teeosa_syn
table:columns.description: Shapefile-truncated name of teeosa_synon (road section synonym).

table:columns.name: soidutee_s
table:columns.description: Shapefile-truncated name of soidutee_synon (carriageway synonym).

table:columns.name: soidutee00
table:columns.description: Shapefile-truncated name of a further soidutee synonym or clear-text field; the publisher's document lists soidutee_synon and soidutee_synon2 and the export also emits their _t variants.

table:columns.name: tee_synon2
table:columns.description: if the road segment is part of the third road then its code from road registry teeosa_synon2 - code of the logical part of that third road (from road registry)

table:columns.name: teeosa_s00
table:columns.description: Shapefile-truncated name of a further teeosa synonym or clear-text field; see the publisher's field document.

table:columns.name: soidutee01
table:columns.description: Shapefile-truncated name of soidutee_synon2 or its clear-text variant; see the publisher's field document.

table:columns.name: soidutee02
table:columns.description: Shapefile-truncated name of soidutee_synon2 or its clear-text variant; see the publisher's field document.

table:columns.name: nimetus
table:columns.description: Name of the object.

table:columns.name: a_tasand
table:columns.description: level of road starting point -1 = below ground level

table:columns.name: l_tasand
table:columns.description: level of road endpoint -1 = below ground level

table:columns.name: ads_oid
table:columns.description: ID of the address data system.

table:columns.name: ads_nimetu
table:columns.description: Shapefile-truncated name of ads_nimetus (address-system name of the road).

table:columns.name: karto_nimi
table:columns.description: same or shortened name for cartographic purposes

table:columns.name: tahtsus
table:columns.description: road importance class for cartographic purposes

table:columns.name: tahtsus_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of tahtsus (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: no_oid
table:columns.description: Identifier not described in the publisher's field document (observed in the shapefile, 2026-09-19).

table:columns.name: markused
table:columns.description: Remarks.

table:columns.name: vajalik
table:columns.description: Attribute to keep record whether the object needs to be checked: 10 = needs to be checked on site, 20 = shape requires correction, 30 = OK, 40 = table attributes require corrections, 50 = additional base document is needed.

table:columns.name: vajalik_t
table:columns.description: Human readable value of vajalik (in Estonian).

table:columns.name: andmeallik
table:columns.description: Base document ID used to insert or update the object's attributes (shapefile-truncated name of andmeallika_id; the ID refers to table alusdokumendid, field KOOD).

table:columns.name: korgusalli
table:columns.description: Base document ID used to insert or update the object's height, i.e. the Z value of each vertex (shapefile-truncated name of korgusallika_id).

table:columns.name: ruumikujua
table:columns.description: Base document ID used to insert or update the object's shape (shapefile-truncated name of ruumikujuallika_id).

table:columns.name: muutmisaeg
table:columns.description: Latest date of object change.

table:columns.name: geom_muutm
table:columns.description: Latest date of the object's geometry change (shapefile-truncated name of geom_muutmisaeg).

table:columns.name: valjavote
table:columns.description: Extraction date from the topographic database.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax and ymax, added by the conversion.
